- Initial release of skill-plantuml.
- Supports generating PlantUML Sequence diagrams (interface 1) and other diagram types (interface 2).
- All generated PlantUML code is saved as .puml files (UTF-8) in the plantuml-draft directory.
- The absolute path of each saved file is provided to the user.
